content:

I buy something successfully from Amazon

I return several weeks later to buy the exact same thing from same supplier using the same bank card which has adequate funds behind it, and is in date for the next two years.

Worried, I go into Amazon to check on the order to find marked in red “PAYMENT REVISION NEEDED”

I’m becoming more and more dissatisfied with this utter bollox, and believe it’s time to stop relying on on Amazon which seems to be becoming a victim of its own success

Buy elsewhere when you can and ditch this app

title: Unsuitable delivery drivers
content:
On 03/07/2026 at approximately 7:30 a.m., an Amazon delivery driver, a woman who appeared to be around 35–45 years old, came to deliver a parcel. She knocked on the door, rang the doorbell, and then attempted to open my front door by pressing the door handle.

After waiting for only around 15 seconds without receiving an answer, she left the parcel and walked away. When I came outside and asked why she had tried to open my door, she was unable to explain herself, as she appeared to have very limited English. Instead of responding, she quickly got into her vehicle and drove away.

I find this behaviour concerning. I would like to understand what screening and training Amazon provides for its delivery drivers, as attempting to open a customer's front door is not what I would expect from someone delivering a parcel. The driver's actions made me feel uncomfortable and raised concerns about customer safety and professionalism.

title: Great assortment of products, delivery and overall service, however open to fraud and app not secure
content:
Been using Amazon for years both in UAE and UK and overall been a happy customer and always my go to shopping destination. Even got the Amazon credit card so I’m committed.

However, the app isn’t secure. The security is weak and account easily cloned. I was paying someone else’s Prime, products and Groceries for 2 months thinking that the wife was making purchases using my card so never questioned. It was only when I started paying for this guys prime I realised that I pay yearly and not monthly.

It was someone else, using my account and getting items delivered to a completely different address. 12 transactions in 2 months and wasn’t flagged by Amazon.

Found out, cancelled the bank card, called Amazon and they confirmed this and said they would investigate. Next day notification from them that nothing was suspicious to my surprise even through the call desk said I didn’t make the purchase. Called again to raise the concern and same confirmation that someone was using my account, again next day closed the log with no resolution. Done this a total of 4 times and still no response from them.

No OTP or verification on the app as another layer of security so don’t leave any of your card details on your account. No Apple Pay option. So in summary, great app to shop from with good prices and products, until something goes wrong and you need to escalate, as won’t get the response or support you need. Haven’t had a call back in over a week.

author: beatlesaint

title: Poor iOS iPad support
content:
I’ve used the app for several years and it the display orientation was always aligned with the iPad orientation, the text was easy to read, the functions that I used most were easily available. Not any more!

The app ignores the iPad orientation; the home screen starts in portrait mode but displays content that appears to be intended for landscape mode - so a lot of content is off the screen and isn’t scrollable. When I navigate into product information, the content is formatted properly but the text is much smaller than before. The effect is that the app is unusable by anyone either elderly or with any real visual impairment.

The wish list is no longer available directly from the home screen (I don’t mean the “alexa wish list” which seems to be more about groceries than the kind of online shopping that I do). Instead, I have to find it via the “profile” tab.

For me, this is a huge backwards step. If things don’t improve soon, I may as well delete the app and use a browser. At least I’ll get functionality and readable text.

title: Why make a good App worse?
content:
This App used to be incredibly user-friendly and productive; but recent updates have removed all the good features and left annoyances.

For example, you can no longer set multiple filter items and then apply them all at one - instead someone obviously thought it was far better to select each filter individually then return you to the search listing.  If you have an idea of what you want and need to set multiple filters, this is now a long tedious operation.

Next, the search results are now split into separate pages which means trying to scroll through multiple items is a drawn out process.  What was wrong with 100 items on each page?

Then there is the Save & Compare feature that was useful for dragging thumbnail pictures from the listing into the Save & Compare list.  This no longer works.

In summary, this used to be a pleasure to use but now it’s been made worse.
